messages:
anya: quick sync 1 — sales wants an 'onramp autopilot' offer: dynamic elevated throughput for new projects that auto-scales down as usage patterns stabilize. They think it helps launches. High-level: make it easy for customers to launch without immediate capacity engineering.

marco: sounds useful but risky. autoscaling promo means bursty hardware demand. we need hard caps and a global concurrency safety net.

priya: customers asked for flexibility: not just a flat 30 days, but profile-based ramps (e.g., short burst vs steady uplift). Sales wants simple commercial model though.

rafael: technical view: implement as a promo profile with two knobs: peak_headroom (tokens/min) and decay_policy (time-based or usage-threshold). default = 30-day timebox with automated decay after median 7-day low-traffic window.

anya: interesting. so default behavior: enable promo profile at signup -> monitor 7-day rolling median; if median traffic drops below baseline threshold for 7 days, reduce uplift gradually; otherwise auto-expire at 30 days. That buys safety.

marco: agree on decay. also add a hard per-account headroom cap and per-route caps. plus an emergency kill switch for SRE. set global_promo_concurrent_limit and region guards.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate: "onramp-autopilot-v1" built. canary scheduled 03:30 UTC to 2%.

rafael: runtime requirements: feature flag, per-account promo metadata (profile, start_ts, decay_state), request tagging for autopilot traffic, and an adaptive token-bucket that enforces both peak and sustained caps. we'll also emit promo.excess_events metric.

priya: commercial shape: Sylvia, do we bill as promo SKU or policy uplift? Partners specifically want a SKU for partner accounting.

sylvia: recommend promo SKU for auditability: SKU=ONRAMP_AUTOPILOT_30 with invoice_meta.promo=ONRAMP_AUTO. We'll treat it as complimentary on eligible plans and attach clear description in billing. Draft clause: "Onramp Autopilot: automated temporary throughput uplift that auto-adjusts based on usage; provided as a promotional benefit and subject to account limits and Acceptable Use Policy."

anya: launch acceptance criteria proposal: (1) telemetry: no >1.6x p95 latency delta during 24h canary and no unbounded queue growth; (2) error rate delta <3%; (3) autopilot control UI + admin API implemented; (4) invoice sample + T&Cs approved; (5) SRE rollback playbook documented.

marco: add to criteria: a synthetic workload test that simulates 200 concurrent small launches in a region to validate global guard behavior. also require automatic disable if promo_active_count > threshold.

rafael: implementation timeline: feature-flagged backend this week, Console UI next week. need to coordinate runtime owners for adaptive limiter.

priya: sales asks for extension options and manual overrides by CS for high-touch customers. propose one manual extension per account (max +14 days) and a partner-extension flow for partner-sourced signups. all manual ops must be logged.

sylvia: legal: manual extension fine with audit trail. require extension_reason and sales_approval fields in invoice/audit metadata. I'll draft wording for addendum.

anya: risk register notes: (a) billing disputes if customers misunderstand auto-scaling, (b) capacity spikes if many enable at once, (c) potential SLO regressions. Mitigations: clear UI copy + bill-preview, global guard + region caps, telemetry + alerting, and canary ramp plan.

ops-bot: canary scheduled: onramp-autopilot-v1 -> 2% at 03:30 UTC. monitoring dashboard enabled.

rafael: logging plan: tag each autopilot request with promo_profile and decay_state. emit metrics: promo_request_ratio, promo_p95_delta, promo_extension_count, promo_node_pressure. create alert if promo_node_pressure > 0.7 for 10m.

marco: add automatic fallback: if p95 delta > 2x or GPU util > 85% for 5m, flip new signups to manual enable and roll back autopilot for a percentage of active promos. SRE to have a one-click kill switch.

priya: customer comms: sales to get template messaging + bill-preview screenshot. Hard requirement: customers must see promo label and remaining days in Console and invoice preview.

anya: decision summary: build Onramp Autopilot as promo SKU (ONRAMP_AUTOPILOT_30) with adaptive decay policy, default ON for self-serve, per-account caps + per-route limits, global/regional guards, manual one-time extension via Sales (audited), partner extension flow, rollout behind feature flag with canary and synthetic stress tests. Action items: Rafael - backend + tagging + canary; Marco - guard + SRE rollback playbook + synthetic test; Sylvia - invoice meta + legal clause; Priya - pilot customers + sales templates + partner flow; Anya - update PRD + launch checklist.

rafael: noted. will open PR and link runtime dashboard here when canary starts.

marco: prepping synthetic test harness now. will run in staging and post results.

sylvia: drafting clause and invoice sample, will post to #legal for review.

priya: lining up 6 pilot customers and two partners for partner-flow test.

anya: great work. meet again after 24h canary + synthetic stress results. :rocket:
